keyPoints.en: Invasion (football, netball, hockey), net/wall (badminton, volleyball, sepak takraw), striking/fielding (cricket, softball), target (bowling, golf, archery).
keyPoints.bm: Serangan (bola sepak, bola jaring, hoki), jaring/dinding (badminton, bola tampar, sepak takraw), memukul/memadang (kriket, sofbol), sasaran (boling, golf, memanah).

keyPoints.en: Football and hockey 11, netball 7 (only GS and GA score), basketball 5.
keyPoints.bm: Bola sepak dan hoki 11, bola jaring 7 (hanya GS dan GA menjaring), bola keranjang 5.

keyPoints.en: Attack: create space, move, pass. Defend: mark, intercept, stay goal-side.
keyPoints.bm: Menyerang: wujudkan ruang, bergerak, hantar. Bertahan: kawal pemain, pintas, berada di antara lawan dan gol.

keyPoints.en: Badminton: rally scoring to 21, lead by 2, maximum 30.
keyPoints.bm: Badminton: mata rali hingga 21, beza 2, maksimum 30.

keyPoints.en: Volleyball: 6 players, max 3 touches (dig, set, spike). Sepak takraw: 3 players — tekong serves.
keyPoints.bm: Bola tampar: 6 pemain, maksimum 3 sentuhan (menerima, mengumpan, merejam). Sepak takraw: 3 pemain — tekong membuat servis.

tip.en: Rules can be updated by sports bodies — check the latest with your coach.
tip.bm: Peraturan boleh dikemas kini oleh badan sukan — semak yang terkini dengan jurulatih.
